questions.stem: Concentric security zones with stronger controls toward the centre describes:
questions.explanation: Layered perimeter defence uses concentric zones, outer perimeter, building exterior, interior, secure rooms, with escalating controls at each layer.

questions.stem: A guard checking photo ID before entry is a:
questions.explanation: Preventive controls stop unauthorised events before they occur. ID checking prevents unauthorised individuals from entering.

questions.stem: CCTV in a server room primarily provides:

choices.D: Detective, records activity for review and investigation

questions.explanation: CCTV is a detective control enabling post-incident investigation. Its primary security value is detection and evidence collection.

choices.D: Requiring authentication in a small enclosed space before a second door opens

questions.explanation: A mantrap has two electronically controlled doors, only one opens at a time. The second requires authentication, preventing piggyback entry.

questions.stem: Bollards at a building entrance prevent:
questions.explanation: Bollards are sturdy posts that physically stop vehicles from being driven into buildings.

questions.stem: A clean desk policy requires employees to:

choices.A: Wipe screens at end of day
choices.B: Place all devices in locked rooms
choices.D: Remove all sensitive materials from their workstation when unattended

questions.explanation: Clean desk policy prevents information theft by requiring employees to secure sensitive documents and media when unattended.

questions.stem: Organised cable management improves physical security by:

choices.A: Making unauthorised cable connections or hardware taps easier to spot

questions.explanation: Organised cabling lets security staff identify unauthorised connections or hardware implants that would be hidden in disorganised cabling.

questions.stem: Maintaining 40–60% relative humidity in a server room primarily prevents:
questions.explanation: Low humidity promotes static electricity buildup causing ESD damage to sensitive electronics. 40–60% balances both ESD and condensation risks.

questions.stem: A visitor sign-in log primarily provides:

choices.D: An accountability audit trail of who accessed the facility and when

questions.explanation: A visitor log records who visited, when, who they met, and how long, supporting investigation and accountability.

choices.C: At least two authorised individuals present for access to sensitive areas or critical operations
choices.D: Two independent background checks for new hires

questions.explanation: TPI requires two authorised people for sensitive access, preventing insider threats by eliminating unsupervised solo access.
